title: Iterative quantum algorithms for the minimum vertex cover problem based on continuous-time quantum walks
summary: We introduce a constraint-preserving hybrid quantum-classical greedy framework for the minimum vertex cover problem, which extends directly to maximum independent set by bitwise complementation. The framework uses projected Pauli-X terms whose sum preserves the feasible subspace and acts within it exactly as the adjacency matrix of a layered graph of feasible covers. This graph is connected, so every feasible cover is linked to the configuration containing all vertices by a sequence of allowed single-vertex flips.
